header.title: ViewTransition
header.description: Reactive wrapper around `document.startViewTransition()`. When `viewKey` (or the child’s `key`) changes it captures the old host, commits the new view inside the native callback, and animates the snapshots with `effect` (`fade`, `slide-*`, `scale`). `name` is the CSS `view-transition-name` (default `gemst-view`). Without the API, `fallback` (`fade` by default) crossfades in CSS, or `none` snaps.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Switch tabs to update `viewKey`. The new snapshot uses `enter` timing; the old one uses `exit`.
playground.noApi: This browser has no View Transition API — CSS fallback is used.

copies.Inbox: Default view. Changing viewKey snapshots this pane, then swaps.
copies.Starred: Second view. The browser crossfades the old/new snapshots.
copies.Sent: Third view. Without the API, fallback="fade" crossfades; fallback="none" or reduced motion snaps.

base.title: Base
base.description: Switch tabs to update `viewKey`. Pass `effect` for fade, slide, or scale on the native snapshots.

texts.sibling: Sibling below — only the named host is snapshotted (document root stays out).
texts.noApi: This browser has no View Transition API — CSS fade fallback is used (or snap if none).

copies.Inbox: Default view. Changing viewKey snapshots this pane, then swaps.
copies.Starred: Second view. The browser crossfades the old/new snapshots.
copies.Sent: Third view. Without the API, fallback="fade" crossfades; fallback="none" or reduced motion snaps.

effectSlide.title: effect slide
effectSlide.description: `effect="slide-left"` — the old snapshot exits toward the start edge; the new one covers from the end. Also `slide-right`, `slide-up`, `slide-down`.

effectScale.title: effect scale
effectScale.description: `effect="scale"` — the old snapshot shrinks; the new one pops in.

timing.title: Enter / exit timing
timing.description: Split `duration` and `easing`. The new snapshot uses enter; the old one uses exit.

presence.title: isIn
presence.description: Toggle `isIn`. Exit captures the current pane and unmounts it inside the native callback.

texts.label: Inbox
texts.copy: Presence via the View Transition API.

sharedName.title: Shared name
sharedName.description: Two hosts share `name`. Wrap the React update with `runViewTransition` so the thumb morphs into the detail pane.

fallbackNone.title: fallback none
fallbackNone.description: `fallback="none"` — without the View Transition API, the next view snaps (no CSS crossfade). With native support this demo still uses the API; `fallback` only applies without it.

skipInitial.title: skipInitial false
skipInitial.description: `skipInitial={false}` — the default `true` skips VT on the first layout (mount / Strict Mode). Set `false` if the first keyed update after mount should be able to animate. Use Remount to see it.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onViewTransition` / `outViewTransition` mark the start and end of the native transition (or the fallback).

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: With `isDisabled` the next view snaps in with no native transition.

asChild.title: No wrapper (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, host styles land on the `section`. Pass `view` as the pane — the child is only the host.

utilities.title: Utility classes
utilities.description: Classes from `utilities.css` go through `classNames.root`. Here `gemst-relative` and `gemst-overflow-hidden`.

header.title: ViewTransition API
header.description: Reference for props, helpers, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types for `ViewTransition`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for effect, presence, shared name, and fallback.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import from `@gem-org/gemsitions/view-transition` with its `view-transition.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`. Also exports `runViewTransition` and `supportsViewTransition`.

items.runViewTransition: Wrap a React update (`flushSync` inside) in `document.startViewTransition`. Useful to morph between two hosts that share the same `name`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and forwards them to the root div, or to the child with asChild. With asChild, the child is only the host: pass view as the pane. Motion runs on the snapshots (::view-transition-old/new), not the live DOM.

items.presence: This is a view swap: the control that changes viewKey / isIn should reflect state. Do not convey information with the snapshot alone.
items.nativeApi: The View Transition API is not in every browser. Use supportsViewTransition() and design a usable fallback.
items.fallback: With fallback="fade" there is a CSS crossfade without the API. With none, the view snaps — do not rely on motion as the only cue.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the view jumps to the final state (no native API and no animated fallback).
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion keeps the animation and adds gemst-ignore-reduced-motion. Only if motion is essential.
items.asChild: With asChild, pick a host with the right semantics (section, div): that element receives the view-transition-name.

items.root: Root (`div` or the child with `asChild`). Sets `view-transition-name`.
items.fallbackFade: CSS fallback mode when there is no native API (`display: grid`).
items.activeDoc: Added to html while a VT runs; style ::view-transition-old/new.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written on the host and/or documentElement when the transition is set up.

items.enterDuration: Duration of the new snapshot. Default `300ms`.
items.exitDuration: Duration of the old snapshot. Default `300ms`.
items.enterDelay: Delay of the new snapshot. Default `0ms`.
items.exitDelay: Delay of the old snapshot. Default `0ms`.
items.enterEasing: Curve of the new snapshot. Default `standard`.
items.exitEasing: Curve of the old snapshot. Default `exit`.
items.name: `view-transition-name` value on the host. Default `gemst-view`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global gemsitions variables the CSS uses as defaults.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Identity, effect, name, fallback, and includeRoot.

state.title: State
state.description: How the animation is turned off.

items.children: Current view. Identity is `viewKey` or the child’s `key`. With `asChild` and `view`, it is only the host.
items.view: Current view with `asChild` (the child is only the host). Also works instead of `children`.
items.asChild: Applies classes, styles, and ref to the single child. Pass `view` as the pane.
items.viewKey: Stable identity. Required to transition if the child has no `key`. Changing it starts the VT.
items.isIn: `true` (default) keeps mounted; `false` plays the old snapshot out and unmounts when done.
items.effect: Snapshot motion: `fade` (default), `slide-*`, or `scale`. Animates `::view-transition-old/new`, not the live DOM.
items.name: CSS `view-transition-name` on the host. The same name on two hosts morphs if the update runs inside a VT. Default `gemst-view`.
items.fallback: Without the API: `fade` (default) CSS crossfade; `none` snap. Unused with native API or with `isDisabled` / reduced motion.
items.skipInitial: `true` (default) does not start VT on the first layout (mount / Strict Mode). `false` allows the first keyed update to animate.
items.includeRoot: `true` also snapshots the document root. Default `false` — only this named host.
items.types: Types passed to `startViewTransition({ types })` if the browser supports them. Style with `:active-view-transition-type()`.
items.unmountOnExit: Unmounts immediately on exit (skips the old snapshot).
items.duration: Duration. With `{ enter, exit }`, `enter` is the new snapshot and `exit` the old one.
items.delay: Wait before each snapshot. Accepts `{ enter, exit }`.
items.easing: Token, timing function, or `{ enter, exit }`. Default enter `standard`, exit `exit`.
items.isDisabled: Turns off the native API; snaps to the next view.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onViewTransition: When the view transition starts playing.
items.outViewTransition: When it finishes, motion is disabled, or the host unmounts.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Combined with `--gemst-view-transition-*`.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
